ios.desc:
ATS Copilot helps job seekers optimise their resumes using AI-powered analysis designed for modern hiring systems.

Most companies use Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) to filter resumes before a human ever sees them. ATS Copilot helps you understand how well your resume performs and how to improve it.

KEY FEATURES

AI Resume Health Score
Get an instant ATS score that evaluates how well your resume is structured and optimised for automated screening systems.

Job Match Scanner
Paste any job description and instantly see how well your resume matches the role. Identify missing keywords and skill gaps.

AI Resume Optimisation
Receive actionable recommendations to improve your resume based on the specific job you are applying for.

Bullet Point Improver
Transform basic resume bullet points into strong, results-driven statements using AI assistance.

Multiple Resume Versions
Manage multiple resume versions tailored for different roles and industries.

Designed for Serious Job Seekers
ATS Copilot focuses on clarity, professionalism, and actionable insights to help you present your experience more effectively.

WHO IS THIS FOR

• Professionals applying for competitive roles
• Students preparing their first resume
• Career switchers optimising resumes for new industries
• Anyone who wants to improve ATS compatibility

SUBSCRIPTION

ATS Copilot Pro unlocks:

• Unlimited job match analysis
• AI-powered resume optimisation
• Advanced resume improvement suggestions
• Multiple resume versions

Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the billing period.
